items.evidence: Seed 1, Normal, judge's bot script: wave changes 5->6 at tick 5202; runners (kind runner, health 1) appear at x=19.95 on ticks 5203, 5293, 5383 (90 ticks = 1.5 s apart), x 19.95->17.0 over 59 ticks (3 u/s); score went 450 -> 675 in wave 6 = 15 runners x 15.

Texts 'Wave 1..6 of 6' / 'Oleada 6 de 6' / 'Vague 6 sur 6'. After wave 5's last walker (tick ~5100) screen stays play, wave 6 starts. Full clear seeds 1,2,7 Normal: won, 675. Leak run (last runner let through): tick 6861 play gate 5 with one runner at x 0.05, tick 6862 won, gate 4, score 660.

Right on Language: en -> es -> fr -> en. French texts: title 'Défendez la porte/Commencer/Réglages/Quitter'; settings 'Réglages, Volume : 5, Langue : Français, Difficulté : Normal/Difficile, Retour'; play 'Score : 465, Vague 6 sur 6, Porte : 5'; paused 'Pause, Reprendre, Titre'; won 'Vous avez gagné !, Score final : 660, Entrée : titre'; lost 'Vous avez perdu'. Frames show the same.

Settings texts [Settings, Volume: 5, Language: English, Difficulty: Normal, Back]; row 2 Right -> Hard, Right Right -> Easy, Left -> Easy; default normal; Spanish 'Dificultad: Normal', French 'Difficulté : Difficile'; Enter on row 3 (Back) returns to title. Frames es_set/fr_set show the row with marker.

Seed 3 first walker health: easy 1, normal 2, hard 3; wave 6 first runner health: easy 1, normal 1, hard 2. Hard: 3 bolts destroyed a walker (+10); Easy: 1 bolt destroyed one. Bot won Easy and Hard with 675.

Run 1 set volume 3, French, Hard -> file {volume:3, language:fr, difficulty:hard}; run 2 with same --settings started at 3/fr/hard. Old-format file {volume:7, language:es} loaded as 7/es/normal. Missing file -> 5/en/normal.
State JSON has 'difficulty' and each walker has 'kind' (walker/runner); --frame wrote PNGs whose IHDR is 800 x 480 (title, play, won, README example).
m01-m19 all rechecked on the changed game and pass (see those items); no previously passing item fails.
CHANGES.md lists the three changes with the files/functions changed (WAVES, wave_plan, POINTS, lang/fr.json, font glyphs, settings row), what was checked and how, and what was wrong before.

defects: French won screen frame: 'VOUS AVEZ GAGNÉ !' at scale 8 is 808 px wide, so the first V and the '!' are clipped at the 800 px edges of the PNG.
Difficulty and Language wrap around (Hard -> Easy on Right) instead of stopping at the ends; the brief does not forbid this.

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4
